subject: Road to pilot: MAP kickoff & stakeholder alignment
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Boyd <leah.boyd@clearco.io>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:02:00 -0500
Subject: Road to pilot — quick MAP kickoff and roles

Hi Leah — great to connect last week. Per our call I wanted to get a short mutual action plan kicked off so we can align on objectives, success criteria, and an initial timeline to pilot Redwood Inference in your analytics stack.

High level goals we heard from your team:
- Validate end-to-end latency for batch scoring (target: < 150 ms p95)
- Confirm integration pattern for private VPC deployment
- Evaluate token-level cost and caching savings on 2–3 representative workloads

Proposed 6-week MAP (draft):
1) Week 0–1: Requirements + stakeholder roster + security questionnaire
2) Week 2–3: Integration pilot (sandbox VPC) + metric collection
3) Week 4: Quality review + cost optimization suggestions
4) Week 5–6: Wrap-up & recommendation for production commit

Can you confirm: (a) that this captures ClearCo's top priorities, (b) who will be the internal champion for delivery/engineering, and (c) whether legal or procurement needs to be looped in now?

I attached a short MAP template (ClearCo_MAP_Template_v1.xlsx) with proposed milestones and owners. If that looks good I can schedule a 30-min kickoff this week to finalize owners and the pilot start date.

Thanks — excited to get moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Attachments: ClearCo_MAP_Template_v1.xlsx
From: Leah Boyd <leah.boyd@clearco.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@clearco.io>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 10:20:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Road to pilot — quick MAP kickoff and roles

Marissa — thanks, this is very clear and matches our expectations. I can act as the champion on the product side and will own acceptance criteria.

Stakeholders to include:
- Carlos Mendez (eng manager) — will coordinate the sandbox VPC and integration (carlos.mendez@clearco.io)
- IT Security (note above) — they will want the SOC2/architecture notes and a short threat model check
- Procurement — expect they will review the SOW in week 4 (I can intro once we have a pilot summary)

Timeline note: we prefer to start the sandbox integration the week of Mar 1 so we can demo results during our March 16 engineering review. If that works for you, please update the MAP accordingly.

I looked at the template and it looks good; attaching a single-page summary our side asked for (SOW-draft-brief.pdf) so procurement has a quick view.

Leah
Leah Boyd
Director, Product Strategy | ClearCo
leah.boyd@clearco.io
Attachments: SOW-draft-brief.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 12:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Road to pilot — quick MAP kickoff and roles

Thanks Leah — that timeline works. Updated plan: target sandbox start week of 2027-03-01, demo to ClearCo engineering on 2027-03-16.

Two quick asks before kickoff:
- Priya (solutions), can you confirm the recommended sandbox footprint and whether we should provision dedicated GPU or use our burst capacity for the pilot?
- Aditya (security), can you pre-fill the architecture & SOC2 checklist so ClearCo Security has a single doc to review during week 0–1?

I’ll schedule a 30-min MAP kickoff for Tue, Feb 22 at 11:00 AM ET and share the invite + MAP doc if that time works for everyone. If not, propose alternatives.

Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 09:30:00 -0500
Subject: Fwd: Road to pilot — quick MAP kickoff and roles

Forwarding the thread from Marissa / ClearCo — pilot target week of Mar 1, demo on Mar 16.

Sean — heads up on timeline and potential need for a temporary dedicated GPU allocation during the sandbox if throughput testing shows higher concurrency. Budget may be modest but we should be prepared to recommend a short reserved pool if needed.

Aditya — can you own the security artifact (SOC2 notes + short threat model) and add any red flags for a VPC deployment? Put a draft in the MAP link below.

Action items for internal team:
- Priya: coordinate sizing recommendation + cost estimate for pilot (I will do this)
- Aditya: security artifact (ETA 2 business days)
- Marissa: finalize kickoff time & update MAP owners

Related: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1MapTemplateStub
